map.正多边形面积（A = n·s² / (4·tan(π/n))） 使用指南: Regular Polygon Area (A = n·s² / (4·tan(π/n))) User Guide
map.输入边数 n（n≥3）与边长 s，使用公式 A=n·s²/(4·tan(π/n): Enter the number of sides n (n≥3) and the edge length s, and the regular polygon area is A=n·s²/(4·tan(π/n)) with n·s²/(4·tan(π/n)), used to estimate the area of regular shapes such as floor tiles, nut sections and flower beds.
map.由边数与边长求正多边形面积（n≥3）。: Area of a regular polygon from the number of sides and the edge length (n≥3).
map.填写「边数 n」。: Enter the number of sides n.
map.工程截面：地砖、螺母截面等边数形状面积: Engineering sections: areas of regular-sided shapes such as floor tiles and nut sections
map.花坛/场地：正 n 边形地块的占地估算: Flower beds and sites: footprint estimate of a regular n-gon plot
map.几何设计：边数→面积的收敛（趋近圆）: Geometry: the convergence of side count to area (approaching a circle)
map.：算法：正 n 边形（边长 s）面积 A=n·s²/(4·tan(π/n))，并: Algorithm: the area of a regular n-gon with edge length s is A=n·s²/(4·tan(π/n)), and the inradius is r_in=s/(2·tan(π/n)). n is an integer ≥3 and s>0; as n→∞ it approaches the circle area πr² (where r is r_in).
map.：例：正六边形 n=6、s=1m → tan(30°)=0.5774、A=6/(: Example: a regular hexagon n=6 with s=1m → tan(30°)=0.5774, A=6/(4×0.5774)=2.5981 m² and the inradius=0.8660m. For a square n=4 with s=2m → A=4×4/(4×1)=4.0000 m² (matching a square of side 2) and the inradius=1.0000m.

map.为什么公式里有 tan(π/n)？: Why is there tan(π/n) in the formula?
map.正 n 边形可拆为 n 个等腰三角形（顶角 2π/n），每个面积=½·s·r_i: A regular n-gon splits into n isosceles triangles (each with vertex angle 2π/n), each of area ½·s·r_in, and r_in=s/(2tan(π/n)); summing gives the formula.
map.n 很大时准吗？: Is it accurate when n is large?
map.n 越大越接近圆；当 n≥12 时与圆面积差别已很小，可作为圆的近似估算使用。: The larger n is the closer it is to a circle; from n≥12 the difference from a circle is already very small, so it works as an estimate of a circle.
